baselines..env.example:
# Environment Configuration
# Copy this file to .env and update the values

# Application
DEBUG=true
HOST=0.0.0.0
PORT=8000

# Allowed web origin for CORS (unset or empty = allow any origin)
CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3001

# Database (if using SQLAlchemy/SQLModel)
DATABASE_URL=file:../../local.db

# OpenAI (if using AI frameworks)
OPENAI_API_KEY=your-openai-api-key

# Anthropic (if using Anthropic SDK)
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your-anthropic-api-key

# Confluent Kafka
KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS=localhost:9092

# Celery (if using task queue)
CELERY_BROKER_URL=redis://localhost:6379/0
CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND=redis://localhost:6379/0

# FastAPI Users
AUTH_SECRET=change-me-to-a-real-secret
USERS_DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///./users.db
# Sentry DSN from your project settings
SENTRY_DSN=
# Sentry environment (development, staging, production)
SENTRY_ENVIRONMENT=development
# Sentry traces sample rate 0.0-1.0 (reduce in production)
SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE=1.0
# Sentry profiles sample rate 0.0-1.0
SENTRY_PROFILES_SAMPLE_RATE=0.1
# Upstash Redis REST URL - get it at https://console.upstash.com
UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL=https://your-upstash-redis.upstash.io
# Upstash Redis REST token - get it at https://console.upstash.com
UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN=your_upstash_redis_rest_token
# Upstash Redis protocol URL for Go, Rust, and Java clients
UPSTASH_REDIS_URL=rediss://default:password@host.upstash.io:6379
# Meilisearch host URL - default for local development
MEILISEARCH_HOST=http://localhost:7700
# Meilisearch API key (master key for development, search key for production)
MEILISEARCH_API_KEY=
